historical_record.description: The Art Commission approved the Phase 3 construction drawings for Sunnyside Playground, asking that the Mangels Avenue entry path be shifted to allow planting against the 14-foot retaining wall.
The Art Commission approved the Phase II plans for a fieldhouse at Sunnyside Playground, Foerster Street and Mangels Avenue.
In a set of names its committee had cleared with the Mayor, the Recreation and Park Commission resolved that Sunnyside Playground be named the Mary Margaret Casey Playground.
The Sunnyside Recreation Center and its Mary Margaret Casey Building were to be dedicated on Saturday, April 17, as the general manager told the Recreation and Park Commission.
